# Running & debugging tests in inspector e2e

**Yarn / Playwright invoke reference.** Authoring and stack: [CLAUDE.md](../../../../CLAUDE.md). Live CLI and trace workflow: [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md). Global CLI install: [cli-installation.md](cli-installation.md).

Work from `rasa/core/channels/inspector-nextgen/e2e/`. Mock MCP (`:8765`) and `rasa inspect` (`:5005`) must be healthy before `yarn e2e:only` — see [CLAUDE.md § Debugging](../../../../CLAUDE.md#debugging).

## Yarn scripts

From [`package.json`](../../../../package.json):

| Goal | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Full run (mock MCP + inspect + tests) | `yarn e2e` |
| Tests only (servers already up) | `yarn e2e:only` |
| One file | `yarn e2e:only tests/home.test.ts` |
| One test by title | `yarn e2e:only tests/home.test.ts -g "test name"` |
| Headed run | `yarn e2e:watch` |
| Playwright UI mode | `yarn e2e:trace` |
| Playwright inspector (`--debug`) | `yarn e2e:debug` |
| Repeat 10× (flake repro) | `yarn e2e:repeat` or `yarn e2e:repeat tests/home.test.ts` |
| Open last HTML report | `yarn report` |

`yarn e2e:only` does **not** start mock MCP or inspect.

From repo root: `make install`, `source .venv/bin/activate`, then `cd` to this directory. Override server URL:

```bash
BASE_URL=http://localhost:5005 yarn e2e:only
```

## Suppressing the auto-opened HTML report

```bash
PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OPEN=never yarn e2e:only tests/home.test.ts
```

Use in debug loops and with `--debug=cli`.

## `--debug=cli`: attach to the real test session

Pauses the test and prints a session name (e.g. `tw-abc123`). Attach to inspect the **same** page state as the test — including `inspectorPage` / `inspectorOptions`.

```bash
# Terminal 1 — mock MCP + inspect on 5005, then:
PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OPEN=never yarn e2e:only tests/home.test.ts --debug=cli

# Terminal 2
playwright-cli attach tw-abc123
playwright-cli snapshot
playwright-cli console
playwright-cli network
```

Edit triads/flows from findings; do not paste CLI steps into `*.test.ts`. Prefer attach over a fresh `playwright-cli open` when setup matters. Full workflow: [SKILL.md § Attach](../SKILL.md#attach-to-a-failing-test---debugcli).

## Post-mortem trace (no live `playwright-cli`)

`playwright-cli show` is for **active** sessions only.

[`playwright.config.ts`](../../../../playwright.config.ts) records traces (on locally, retain-on-failure in CI). Per failed test, `test-results/<test>/` includes `trace.zip`, screenshot, and `error-context.md` (ARIA snapshot at failure).

| Source | What you get |
| --- | --- |
| Terminal + `error-context.md` | Assertion message; DOM at failure (locators) |
| `yarn report` / HTML | Same attachments in a browser UI |
| `npx playwright trace …` | Action timeline, `--errors-only`, file:line, console/requests — see [SKILL.md § Post-mortem](../SKILL.md#post-mortem-preferred-after-any-failure) |

Use **`npx playwright trace`** from this package (`@playwright/test` 1.60.0) before opening the HTML report or `show-trace`. Mid-flow UI failures benefit most; first-line assertion failures are often covered by terminal + `error-context.md`.

## What not to do

- Don't run `npx playwright test` outside this directory — you lose `playwright.config.ts` and path aliases.
- Don't add `--debug=cli` to committed scripts or CI.
- Don't use codegen output as committed tests — use `generate-locator` for individual locators only.
- Don't use `show-trace` as the first post-mortem step — use `npx playwright trace` per SKILL.md.
